directory_users_deleted_check.name: directory_users_deleted_check
directory_users_deleted_check.value: not "directory_users"."deleted" or ("directory_users"."name" is null and "directory_users"."name_key" is null and "directory_users"."email" is null)

invitation_batch_replays_state_check.name: invitation_batch_replays_state_check
invitation_batch_replays_state_check.value: ("invitation_batch_replays"."state" = 'reserved' and "invitation_batch_replays"."lease_id" is not null and "invitation_batch_replays"."outcome" is null) or ("invitation_batch_replays"."state" = 'committed' and "invitation_batch_replays"."lease_id" is null and "invitation_batch_replays"."outcome" is not null)

outbox_events_lease_check.name: outbox_events_lease_check
outbox_events_lease_check.value:
("outbox_events"."status" = 'leased' and "outbox_events"."lease_token" is not null and "outbox_events"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
        or ("outbox_events"."status" <> 'leased' and "outbox_events"."lease_token" is null and "outbox_events"."lease_expires_at" is null)
